SELECT 'fmt_multi' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(distinct format)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_ids', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_rows', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_ids', count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_multi_per_line', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_gt_sold', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net>f.net_amount+0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_before_sale', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date<f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_return_date', (SELECT max(return_date)-DATE '2000-01-01' FROM fact_return_line)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_store_key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IS NULL

calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, s.store_id=999 is999, p.category='ZZ Test' zz, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) sold,
  sum(f.net_amount) filter (where f.net_amount<0) negs, count(*) filter (where f.quantity<=0) badqty,
  min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, cs.format, f.net_amount AS sold_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, sold.format,
       ROUND(SUM(sold.sold_net),2) AS sold_net, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0),2) AS refunded_net,
       ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(sold.sold_net),2) AS return_rate_pct,
       COUNT(r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines, MAX(0) AS x
FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3

SELECT cs.format, count(*) ret_lines, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  max(r.return_date - f.sale_date) max_lag, min(r.return_date) min_ret, max(r.return_date) max_ret,
  sum(case when s.store_id=999 then 1 else 0 end) r999, sum(case when p.category='ZZ Test' then 1 else 0 end) rzz,
  sum(case when s2.store_id<>s.store_id then 1 else 0 end) diff_store
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id)
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cs.format, count(*) n,
  round(avg(r.refund_net/nullif(f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity,0)),4) avg_ratio,
  count(*) filter (where abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity)>0.02) mismatch,
  count(*) filter (where r.quantity_returned>f.quantity) overqty,
  count(*) filter (where r.reason_code is null) nullreason
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id)
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
